adaptation.loss: cosine-decayed clean entropy plus masked-view stop-gradient consistency on retained samples
adaptation.trainable: generator BN1d affine + time_projection + time_positions + head LayerNorm affine; final_norm/classifier frozen
adaptation.bn_stats: track_running_stats=True; all BN eval during support/query; source running_mean/var/num_batches_tracked immutable
adaptation.dropout: support model.train with BN eval; query model.eval

permissions.source_labels: not used for adaptation; source/valid inputs only for split verification

decision.primary: 9-cell mean Macro-F1 >0.72 and paired mean delta vs tent_bn >0
decision.report: all seed/date pairs and Macro-F1/NAR/recovery contrasts; no early stopping or tuning
decision.collapse_diagnostic: report finite logits, predicted unique classes and max predicted-class fraction; no query-based tuning
decision.selection: no tuning; terminal step800; no early stopping based on labels
decision.retention_target: 30% to 50% descriptive target; not used for tuning
decision.interpretation: joint Scale-Lock plus Span-Invariance efficacy on observed TemporalDrift; no isolated component causality or cross-dataset claim

evaluation.protocol: independent unlabeled support adaptation then fixed-state query; no query statistics or gradients
evaluation.query_order: existing query index order; no shuffle
evaluation.model_mode: support train with BN eval and locked output head; query model.eval
evaluation.control: 72 historical rows in 8 conditions, matched seed/date/query; no repeated training
evaluation.caveat: Scale-Lock and Span-Invariance are jointly changed relative to TENT; this run cannot isolate their separate effects

development_exposure.basis: user-specified hypothesis motivated by observed TENT logit collapse and repeated support updates
development_exposure.dataset: observed TemporalDrift development data; not independent confirmation
